rationale: At the maximum label budget, the four-episode changed-execution context condition passes all three declared rival comparisons while nineteen neighboring conditions fail. The ten presentation shifts show nine increases in structured loss and one small decrease; the changed-execution rankings vary with history and evidence. Admit exactly their second registered fit from the immutable forest. This matched panel tests whether the reader rankings and native-to-shift changes persist after changing the training draw at the largest label budget; average both fits within each whole lineage. It completes a predeclared training-sensitivity comparison, not additional independent worlds or untouched confirmation. No new setting, criterion, lineage or seed is introduced. Lower-budget and native immutable comparisons remain separate; no repeat of valid jobs.
